lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a repeating grid-like geometric structure across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, positioning the highest-intensity blobs at the nodes of a rectangular grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to shadow-cast low-intensity pixels on the ventral side.
